verdict.rationale: The product's own docs show a few narrow cases of acting on several items in one request: depositing multiple checks together and bundling packages into one shipment. Automation rules and the API/Zapier are rule automation and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit as bulk operations, and probes found no OpenAPI spec showing batch endpoints. Missing for 10: a general multi-select bulk action across mail items (scan, forward, shred, tag), documented batch API endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
